title: GENERATOR
body: The Generator, an early investigation into artificially intelligent architecture, was designed with no specific program, but only a desired end-effect, in mind. The project was commissioned by Howard Gilman for a site at the Gilman Paper Corporation's White Oak Plantation in Florida to provide a facility to house dance, theater, and visiting artists. Cedric Price explored a type of architecture that, like medicine, would operate less as a remedy for the ills of society and more as a preventive system, creating flexible conditions previously thought impossible within a socially beneficial environment.
